answer: The delta holds work receipts rather than names, so the wander of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on invitation quota tree, revoked by a single upheld challenge, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the horizon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
